title: Integral quiver presentations for $\mathscr R$-trivial semigroup algebras
summary: Semigroups in which right divisibility is a partial order, that is, $\mathscr R$-trivial semigroups, have been studied by people in algebraic combinatorics in connection with Markov chains (especially left regular bands). Margolis and the author showed that the quiver of the algebra of an $\mathscr R$-trivial monoid is field independent. We prove here that the integral semigroup ring of an $\mathscr R$-trivial semigroup has a bound quiver presentation provided that it is unital. This then gives a uniform quiver presentation over any field via extension of scalars.
